The Planner wrongfully declared that "B) The boiling point of bromine is colder than room temperature" is false even though it is true that "A) The boiling point of oxygen is colder than room temperature". The mistake stems from a misinterpretation of the constraints and relationships between the given statements and the context of true or false. A focused analysis should have revealed that A was true according to the problem's requirements.
